en.name: XML ↔ JSON
en.short: Convert XML to JSON and back, keeping attributes. For SOAP and B2B APIs.
en.title: XML to JSON converter (and JSON to XML)
en.description: Convert XML to JSON and JSON to XML online, keeping attributes, text nodes, CDATA and comments. Numbers and booleans can be typed automatically. Ideal for SOAP, B2B integrations and legacy APIs. 100% in your browser.
en.lead: Attributes become keys with a prefix (@_id) so nothing is lost on the way back.
en.placeholder: Paste XML (or JSON after pressing Swap)…

es.title: Convertir XML a JSON (y JSON a XML)

es.placeholder: Pega XML (o JSON después de pulsar Intercambiar)…
